decisions.statement: A day page declares the stretches beside that day.
A reader reaches a stretch through the declaration its day page has.
A day carrying rows and declaring no stretches reads as a day with no stretch.
The declaration is written the first time a row lands on a day.
A day page already declaring the stretches is left unchanged.
The rows of the last day a landing writes are handed to the write as the body.
A day page a landing rewrites is written whether that day is the last or not.
A row arrives here already composed.

definition: the files a landing writes beside the day that landing lands rows on
